title: ticfac watch shows a worker's thinking and tool calls live; operator steer; heartbeat from commits
description: Step 8: watch renders thinking and tool calls from the commit stream (local and cloud), a ticfac steer command, the f6o heartbeat from the commit sequence; optionally publish settled events to the run feed (n0r).
notes: 2026-10-04 17:07 - 2026-10-04, live in 43y's own run: pom's pi worker ran `find / -name pi-durable -maxdepth 8` (a whole-disk scan, 17 min, no CPU), and the stuck watch's nudge only QUEUED a steering message behind the hung tool call, so nothing happened until the tool was killed by hand. Requirement for the pi-durable stuck nudge: when the in-flight tool call has made no progress past the stall bound, the steer must ABORT that tool call (pi-durable abort / tool cancel) and tell the model why, not queue behind it; plus a per-tool-call wall bound for shell commands.
acceptance_criteria: frame/model tests for the live worker view; steer round-trip test
